exposure: Genotypic groups of the OPRM1 A118G and UGT2B7 C802T variants
COMT, ABCB1, CYP2D6, UGT2B7, and OPRM1 gene polymorphisms
finding: OPRM1 A118G and UGT2B7 C802T gene variants were found to predict codeine consumption after cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study examined codeine requirements and pain management in women following cesarean section.
